pages.text: Clicks while carried. Hold it to read counts, rate and dose.

pages.title: Reading
pages.text: Held, it shows CPM, RU/s and your dose on a log dial. Above $(bold)200 RU/s$() it reads OFF SCALE.$(br2)Above about 15 RU/s the clicks blur into a roar.$(br2)$(flavor)If it screams, leave.$()
A glass pane, copper, redstone and iron.
